concepts.headline: FSA/HSA ELIGIBLE.
concepts.prompt: A real low-angle photo on a hospital parking-garage floor in late-afternoon sun with long shadows of railings: a nurse's legs mid-stride in heather-grey scrub joggers, cropped at the knee, wearing the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference, very large and sharp at true proportions, one heel lifted. Lower left: small white text "ComfortWear", then huge heavy white all-caps on two lines "FSA/HSA" / "ELIGIBLE.", then a white rounded pill with dark text "Pay with pre-tax dollars". No seals, no association logos. All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin. No other text anywhere.

concepts.headline: Bunions? Pay for them with your HSA/FSA.
concepts.prompt: Upper 60%: light grey background with a thin white square grid. Centered, a top-down translucent grey outline of a shoe with a wide, rounded toe box, and inside it a realistic black-and-white x-ray of foot bones, the big toe joint angled outward like a bunion, with room to spare around the toes. Four white dashed curved arrows around the outline pointing outward to show the extra room. Lower 40%: white panel. Left: dark text "Bunions?" then heavy black two-line "Pay with your" / "HSA/FSA." Right, overlapping the panel edge: one black-and-white shoe from the product reference in side view, large and sharp at true proportions. Bottom center tiny grey text "HSA/FSA eligibility may vary by plan." All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin. No other text anywhere.
